description: Immutable data object representing a Recurring Deposit product in the Fineract project, extending DepositProductData with specific properties and template methods.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductData
classes.description: Immutable class representing a recurring deposit product with properties, constructors, and template methods.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template RecurringDepositProductData with default values and options for dropdowns.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified charges.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Returns a new instance with template data for dropdowns, based on an existing product.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified interest rate charts.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal RecurringDepositProductData with given id and name.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified accounting mappings and related data.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new RecurringDepositProductData based on existing DepositProductData and additional parameters.
